note: AFMX judgment scores, 1 to 5. Evidence is not here: it is set by the rule in criteria.json from patterns.json. scripts/build_site.py adds the four and applies the pass rule.

aftershocks.why: Tells a reader that the day of a large fall is rarely the end of it, and for roughly how long. Recomputed from public daily data.

contagion.why: The strong result is Tokyo following New York overnight. AFMX records the US market only and country screens are postponed, so a reader of a card cannot use it. Trouble in one US sector did not lead the market.

overlap.why: The ledger holds many open risks at once; whether several are moving together is the question a reader has. The present count needs the workflow to be rerun.

reverberation.why: Closest to the product's point, but the measurement fixed in advance (credit spread still wider at the recovery) showed no effect. The VIX was higher at 18 of 24 recoveries; that was not the measurement chosen beforehand, so it is noted and not used.

dates.why: Needs hand-kept date lists. FOMC days did not move more than other days, and six funding gaps show no common direction.
